steps.caption: Starting point: channel 1 plays pattern 1 on steps 1-4 with the notes C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, and no masks are set. Turn E1 to open Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3, then turn E2 to Vel. The value reads X.

With no step held, turn E3 right until the screen reads 80. The channel velocity replaces the pattern's velocities: every note plays at 80. This loop plays C, D, E and F, not one repeated note, so read the pitches in the MIDI strip.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 3 at (3,4), turn E3 right until the screen reads 100 and release. Step 3 is the accent: the MIDI strip shows 80, 80, 100, 80.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 left until the screen reads 35, and keep holding. The ST02 readout shows this step exception before you release it.
Release step 2. The screen returns to the channel default 80, while the step exception remains. The MIDI phrase is 80, 35, 100, 80: the quiet ghost note leads into the accent.

provenance.scope: complete public playback validation, including two cycles, closing onset, releases and Stop

title: Set a ghost note and an accent
